provenance.post_title: Dragons That Cause Lots of Swearing
provenance.asset_description: A group of adventurers duck out of the way as two dragons battle it out in an icy cave. A silver and white scaled dragon breaths an icy blast down onto a smaller green scaled dragon, coating its back and wings in ice.
